Article Title: Switch to cleaner fuel: Study calls for tech-neutral stance
Article Text:
Switch to cleaner fuel

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Delhi has the strongest CNG infrastructure among the cities assessed in a TERI study and, along with Bengaluru, also has relatively strong EV infrastructure.The study, supported by the Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board (PNGRB), found that effective charging capacity was considerably lower in Lucknow, Guwahati, Dhanbad and Chamba. It said infrastructure readiness was a key determinant of the timing of the transition and that national transition pathways needed regionally differentiated implementation strategies.The “Study on Comparative Assessment of Vehicular Fuels in India’s Energy Transition” examined petrol, diesel, CNG, electricity and LNG across two-wheelers, three-wheelers, private and commercial four-wheelers, light commercial vehicles (LCVs) and heavy-duty vehicles. It covered Delhi, Mumbai, Mumbai Port, Surat, Ahmedabad, Guwahati, Lucknow, Bengaluru, Dhanbad and Chamba.The study found that India should not adopt one fuel or technology as a universal replacement, with different technologies performing different roles across vehicle fleets, applications and stages of the transition.It found that EVs currently provide the lowest ownership costs for two-wheelers and three-wheelers, while CNG offers a relatively balanced and deployment-ready mobility solution across a wide range of personal and commercial applications.The study said CNG has a strong position in passenger cars, taxis, buses and LCVs, while LNG remains particularly relevant for long-haul freight.The study was based partly on a primary survey of 2,315 vehicle owners and drivers across 10 locations, using stratified random sampling. The survey covered vehicle usage, travel distance, mileage, infrastructure access, fuel and maintenance expenditure, technology preferences and willingness to retrofit.Economic considerations emerged as the strongest factor in the assessment, accounting for 31.49% of the overall weighting, followed by environmental considerations at 22.34% and technical factors at 21.25%. The report said the weights reflected the importance of affordability, ownership cost and operating economics in technology selection.The study said CNG-powered vehicles have the lowest overall life-cycle emissions among the fuel options assessed for several passenger and commercial vehicle segments. It also said environmental performance cannot be judged solely through tailpipe emissions, with EV performance influenced by electricity generation, battery manufacturing and material requirements.The findings come amid a continuing debate over the role of vehicles and fuels in Delhi-NCR’s air pollution and the effectiveness of past interventions. Tarun Kapoor, advisor to PM, said better data was needed to guide policy. “Good authentic data is very urgently needed. Whatever interventions we’ve done in the past, it’s been like hitting in the dark and the results have not really been the way it was thought,” he said.The study also said electrification changes rather than eliminates energy-security risks by shifting some dependence from petroleum towards electricity infrastructure, critical minerals, imported automobile components and battery supply chains.“The real policy question is not which fuel should replace all others, but rather which fuel is best suited for which application, under what operating conditions and at what stage of India’s transition journey,” said AK Tiwari, member, PNGRB.The study recommended a technology-neutral framework at the national level, with differentiated approaches based on vehicle segment, region and application. It also called for accelerated CNG infrastructure development, greater use of CBG and differentiated CNG and LNG strategies, with LNG focused on long-haul mobility.
Article Summary: Delhi has the strongest cng infrastructure among the cities assessed in a teri study. Bengaluru also has relatively strong ev infrastructure. Effective charging capacity was considerably lower in lucknow, guwahati, dhanbad and chamba. Study found that india should not adopt one fuel or technology as a universal replacement.

Article Title: LPG price hike: 19-kg commercial cylinder gets Rs 62.50 costlier; new Aadhaar rule kicks in for domestic users
Article Text:
Commercial LPG gets costlier

The price of a 19-kg commercial LPG cylinder has risen by Rs 62.50 from Thursday, October 1, taking the price to Rs 2,810. This follows a Rs 9.50 increase in September, when the cylinder was priced at Rs 2,747.50. ATF prices have also gone up by around Rs 16 per litre, from Rs 121 to Rs 137 per litre.The changes come as domestic LPG consumers face a new requirement from October 1, 2026. Those seeking to book refills at the regulated Retail Selling Price (RSP) with applicable subsidy will now need to have completed Biometric Aadhaar Authentication (BAA).The authentication requirement is aimed at ensuring that subsidised LPG reaches genuine and deserving households. Each LPG connection is linked to an Aadhaar-authenticated consumer to prevent diversion of subsidised domestic cylinders for commercial and industrial use, remove duplicate and ineligible connections, and make subsidy delivery more targeted and transparent.Consumers who have already completed BAA will not need to repeat the process and can continue booking refills as before. Those who have not completed it will be able to book a refill at the RSP with subsidy once their authentication is completed.Consumers can complete the authentication process through several channels. During refill delivery, the delivery person can carry out BAA on the spot using the OMC mobile application.The process can also be completed by visiting the LPG distributor's showroom. Consumers can alternatively complete it themselves from home through their OMC's mobile application: IndianOil ONE for Indane customers, HelloBPCL for Bharatgas customers and HP PAY for HP Gas customers.Consumers who are unwilling or unable to complete BAA can still receive LPG. They will have to register their choice through their OMC's digital channels, including the consumer web portal, mobile app, WhatsApp chatbot, IVRS or other available channels.In such cases, LPG will be supplied at the applicable market price without subsidy, in 5-kg or 10-kg cylinders, subject to local availability with the OMC.Consumers who have not yet completed BAA have been urged to do so through any of the available channels, which are accessible in both urban and rural areas.
Article Summary: The price of a 19-kg commercial lpg cylinder has risen by rs 62.50 from thursday, october 1. This follows a rs 9.50 increase in september, when the cylinder was priced at rs 2,747.50. Atf prices have also gone up by around rs 16 per litre, from rs 121 to rs 137 perlitre.

Article Title: Travis Kelce's $200 million Six Flags investment faces new low as investors push for a potential sale
Article Text:
Travis Kelce (Getty Images)

Six Flags faces mounting financial pressure

Travis Kelce’s Six Flags investment faces another test

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Six Flags is facing a fresh challenge after an investor group that includes Travis Kelce pushed the theme park company to consider a possible sale. The move comes as the operator deals with heavier losses, fewer visitors and pressure on its stock price. Jana Partners, which joined Kelce and other investors in taking a stake in Six Flags, is now seeking action from the company’s board. The development marks a sharp turn from the group’s earlier effort to help strengthen the parks and improve their appeal to families.Jana Partners reportedly contacted Six Flags’ board on Tuesday and asked it to bring in an investment bank to examine a potential sale. The request followed disappointment over the company’s latest financial results, which showed how difficult the current environment has become for the theme park operator.Six Flags posted a $203 million net loss for the second quarter, more than double the $100 million loss recorded during the same period a year earlier. Attendance also fell. The company reported 13.1 million guest visits, down about 7% from 14.2 million visits in the comparable period.The pressure has also reached the stock market. Six Flags shares traded at about $12.43 on Wednesday, roughly half their yearly peak of close to $25.Jana Partners and fellow investors, including Kelce, acquired a combined stake of around 9% in Six Flags last October. Their investment was valued at roughly $200 million at the time. Jana had previously focused on improving the company's marketing and customer experience while also considering strategic options that could increase shareholder value.Six Flags said it remains focused on its investors and its wider business plans."We have a history of engaging constructively with all of our shareholders and value their perspectives. We are focused on executing on our strategic priorities and are committed to maximizing shareholder value."Kelce's connection to Six Flags goes beyond his investment. The Kansas City Chiefs star has long had an attachment to Cedar Point in Ohio, a park he visited while growing up.When the investment was announced, Kelce shared his excitement about helping shape the company's future."Couldn't pass up the opportunity to continue the tradition and make Cedar Point and Six Flags even more special for the next generation of families!"He added, "Excited to partner with JANA Partners as an investor in Six Flags. So crazy to even imagine this is real, but you gotta love it when life comes full circle."The company is also dealing with legal challenges involving its X2 roller coaster at Six Flags Magic Mountain in California. Three people who say they suffered serious brain injuries after riding the attraction have filed lawsuits. The coaster, known for rotating seats and head-first drops, remains closed.Attorney Christopher Bulone said, "No ride like that should be allowed to exist," according to CNN.Six Flags declined to comment on the pending lawsuits but confirmed to KABC that the ride "remains closed at this time."
Article Summary: Travis kelce's six flags investment faces another test. Six flags posted a $203 million net loss for the second quarter, more than double the $100 million loss recorded during the same period a year earlier. The company is also dealing with legal challenges involving its x2 roller coaster in california.

Article Title: GST collections cross Rs 2 lakh crore again, rise 14.7% in September
Article Text:
GST collections cross Rs 2 lakh crore

India’s gross Goods and Services Tax (GST) collections once again crossed the Rs 2 lakh crore mark in September, rising 14.7% year-on-year to Rs 2.04 lakh crore, according to government data. The increase was driven by higher revenue from both domestic transactions and imports.Revenue from domestic transactions grew 10.1% to Rs 1.38 lakh crore in September 2026, compared with Rs 1.25 lakh crore in the corresponding month last year. GST revenue from imports, meanwhile, rose 25.9% year-on-year to Rs 65,525 crore from Rs 52,031 crore.Gross Integrated GST (IGST) collections increased to Rs 1.20 lakh crore during the month, against Rs 1.02 lakh crore in September 2025. Central GST collections stood at Rs 37,762 crore, while State GST collections were at Rs 45,363 crore.The rise in gross collections came even as GST refunds declined during the month. Total refunds stood at Rs 27,001 crore in September, down 3% from Rs 27,848 crore a year earlier.According to Abhishek Jain, indirect tax head & partner at KPMG, the growth in GST collections is encouraging, but the sharp rise in import GST needs to be examined further.“Gross GST collections growing 14.7% in September despite global headwinds is very encouraging. As import GST is up nearly 26%; it's important to see how much of that is raw materials versus finished goods.”Jain further added, “It’ll be good to analyse this in detail, specifically if it signals already stronger domestic manufacturing or there is a need for further push, thereby making stronger the case for continuing and expanding schemes like PLI.”Domestic refunds fell 13.5% year-on-year to Rs 13,504 crore. In contrast, export GST refunds processed through ICEGATE rose 10.2% to Rs 13,497 crore.With refunds taken into account, net GST collections grew faster than gross collections. Net revenue rose 18.1% year-on-year to Rs 1.77 lakh crore in September, compared with Rs 1.50 lakh crore in September 2025.Net domestic GST revenue increased 13.5% to Rs 1.24 lakh crore, while net revenue from customs-related GST jumped 30.8% to Rs 52,028 crore.The September figures also pushed up the GST collection tally for the first six months of the financial year. Between April and September, gross GST collections rose 11.6% to Rs 12.46 lakh crore, compared with Rs 11.17 lakh crore in the same period of 2025-26.Net GST collections during the April-September period increased 10.4% to Rs 10.66 lakh crore from Rs 9.65 lakh crore a year earlier.In terms of states, Maharashtra emerged as the largest contributor among the states listed, recording GST revenue of Rs 29,986 crore in September, a 15% year-on-year increase. Karnataka's collections rose 16% to Rs 13,884 crore, while Gujarat recorded Rs 12,222 crore, up 17%.Uttar Pradesh and Telangana both registered 18% growth in GST revenue during the month. Uttar Pradesh collected Rs 8,882 crore, while Telangana recorded Rs 5,327 crore.
Article Summary: Gst collections once again crossed the rs 2 lakh crore mark in september. The increase was driven by higher revenue from both domestic transactions and imports. Central gst collections stood at rs 37,762 crore, while state gst collections were at rs 45,363 crore.

Article Title: Stephen Curry’s reported frustration over Caitlin Clark’s $16M Under Armour offer comes back into focus with her recent Nike shoe launch
Article Text:
Stephen Curry’s reported frustration over Caitlin Clark’s $16M Under Armour offer comes back into focus with her recent Nike shoe launch (Getty Images)

Stephen Curry and Under Armour wanted Caitlin Clark before Nike landed her

Caitlin Clark now has the Nike signature shoe Under Armour tried to secure

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Stephen Curry’s reported frustration with Under Armour over Caitlin Clark’s failed recruitment is back in focus again. Clark’s first Nike signature shoe, the Caitlin 1, launches in the US on Thursday, nearly two years after Nike beat competing offers to secure her.Under Armour reportedly offered Clark $16 million over four years. Nike agreed to an eight-year deal worth a reported $28 million, giving Clark the signature shoe that now reaches stores.Clark became one of the biggest names in basketball before entering the WNBA, and Under Armour reportedly wanted her inside Curry Brand. Bloomberg reported on Nov. 24, 2025, that Curry and Under Armour pursued Clark, but the company’s offer trailed Nike’s proposal. People familiar with the situation told Bloomberg that the failed pursuit became one “sore point” for Curry.The report came shortly after Curry and Under Armour ended their partnership on Nov. 13, 2025. Their relationship began in 2013, and Curry launched Curry Brand with Under Armour in 2020.Bloomberg also reported that Curry and his advisers had grown frustrated with what they viewed as underinvestment in the brand.Under Armour, however, pushed back on the idea that Clark played a role in the split.An Under Armour spokesperson told Complex that the claim was “unfortunate and untrue,” adding that both sides rejected the premise that Clark contributed to the separation.Curry kept his own public statement focused on what Under Armour had built with him. In the Nov. 13, 2025 announcement about the separation, Curry said, “Under Armour believed in me early in my career and gave me the space to build something much bigger and more impactful than a shoe. I’ll always be grateful for that.”He added, “What Curry Brand stands for, what I stand for and my commitment to that mission will never change. It’s only growing stronger. I’m excited for a future that’s focused on aggressive growth with a continued commitment to keep showing up for the next generation.”Clark’s Nike deal has now moved from a contract on paper to a product fans can buy.Recently, Nike released the Caitlin 1 globally at $140 in North America. The first release includes the “Caitlin Blue” and “Warning Code Yellow” colorways. Nike also launches an 18-piece apparel collection alongside the shoe.Clark discussed the milestone with The Associated Press in Germany in September 2026.“I’m just super excited,” Clark told AP. “I look down at my feet and I’m, man, I’m wearing my shoes. There’s not many people that get a Nike signature shoe.”She also explained how distant the achievement once felt. “I don’t even think that’s something I dreamed about as a kid, because it felt so far away from something that I could ever achieve. I was always a kid that wanted the coolest shoes and I’m so excited,” Clark told AP.The Caitlin 1 also reflects Clark’s input. Nike says she challenged its designers to improve her first step, step-back separation and shot release. The shoe uses Nike Opticast, a forefoot Air Zoom Turbo unit and full-length Cushlon foam.
Article Summary: Caitlin clark’s first nike signature shoe, the caitlin 1, launches in the us on thursday. Under armour reportedly offered clark $16 million over four years. People familiar with the situation said the failed pursuit became one “sore point” for curry.

Article Title: Reggie leaks Kai Cenat conversation, claims streamer left his ‘cry for help’ message unanswered
Article Text:

Reggie and Kai Cenat’s private messages show his attempts to reach out

Fanum sends Reggie a message about stepping away from the noise

Reggie, also known as “Lil Rodney Son,” has shared screenshots of his private conversation with Kai Cenat after saying he needed to speak with the streamer as a “brother” rather than a content creator. The messages show Reggie trying to reach Cenat and later asking him to answer an important call. Reggie posted the screenshots on Instagram on September 29, along with the caption, “Why u leave me on seen ? I needed u ? It’s ok tho the world gon know the REAL KAI CENAT.” The messages came days after Reggie spoke publicly about his personal struggles and his issues with the Clover Boys.In the screenshots shared by Reggie, he appeared to ask Kai Cenat for a private conversation. He said he wanted to meet and talk “in person” and described the conversation as something that needed to happen between them as brothers.Cenat replied that he had watched Reggie’s YouTube videos and asked when he would be “back.” Reggie then made it clear that he did not want the discussion to be about content.“But I wanna talk to you as a brother and not a content creator and the 1st. I deactivated my page rn.”Cenat responded, “Ok, bet… I’m here.”The exchange did not end there. On Friday, September 25, Reggie sent another message asking Cenat to answer his call.“Yoo… Answer this call… This **** important… Like cry for help.”The screenshots appear to show that the message was left on delivered. Reggie later used the exchange to question why Cenat had not responded when he was asking for help.The messages were shared shortly after Reggie’s September 27 YouTube video, “THE TRUTH ABOUT ME AND EVERYTHING PART 1,” in which he spoke emotionally about his past and made serious allegations involving his family and other streamers. Reggie also made a claim involving 17-year-old RaKai and Kai Cenat. RaKai later rejected that claim, saying he “never got touched in any way growing up.”After sharing the Kai Cenat screenshots, Reggie also posted a message from AMP member Roberto “Fanum.” The message focused on Fanum’s own experience with online pressure and his decision to step away from situations that affected his peace.Fanum wrote:“I been ****ed up for a long time, mud. So I learned a lot through the years. But the first thing I would do is go to wherever I felt the happiest. Wherever I ain’t feel no pain, just so I can breathe. For me, that was DR. I would disappear for so long because everyone had an opinion bout me, and none of it was fact. I understand, to an extent, the pain/frustration u feelin nd i need u to get away from the noise. Nobody online gives af bout none of us. ”He then explained that he had taken steps to control who could contact him and encouraged Reggie to keep going.“I just bought a 2nd phone to try and limit who can contact me. I fight every day to stay here gang, real ****. Every day I fight, bro, n it’s hard mud, but I gotta keep pushing. U gotta keep fighting too. I know **** may not be where it needs to be right now, but that can change. Just always gotta remind urself that u gotta keep going.”Sportskeeda reported the DM exchange and Fanum’s message as Reggie continued speaking publicly about his fallout with the Clover Boys.

Reggie said he needed to speak with the streamer as a “brother” rather than a content creator. The messages came days after reggie spoke publicly about his personal struggles and his issues with the clover boys.

Article Title: Bombay HC to X: Remove video against Serum Institute, Adar Poonawalla
Article Text:
Bombay High Court has directed X Corp to take down a recent video uploaded by Yohan Tengra.





MUMBAI: Bombay High Court has directed X Corp to remove a video against Serum Institute of India Pvt Ltd and its CEO Adar Poonawalla that was uploaded by a social media influencer Yohan Tengra immediately after its June 5, 2023 order.Justice Gauri Godse of HC on Tuesday passed the order on SII and Poonawalla’s interim application in the pending defamation suit regarding content posted against the company and its COVID-19 vaccine. She also issued show-cause notices to Tengra, his organisation Anarchy for Freedom India, Ambar Koiri and TV 10 L.I.V.E, an online news portal, as to why action should not be taken for defying HC’s order. The notices are returnable on Oct 27.The application said Tengra and four defendants were restrained by the June 5, 2023 order from publishing or circulating defamatory videos and content. The same night Tengra uploaded a fresh video. On June 9, 2023, the plaintiffs issued a takedown notice to Google and X. Google complied but X refused, stating HC’s order was not issued against it.Advocate Karl Tamboly, for SII and Poonawalla, said videos uploaded were held to be unlawful by the June 5, 2023 order.Hence, videos and content of a like nature are also directed to be removed. He said in the absence of Tengra complying with HC’s direction, X is obligated to remove the objectionable content. Advocate Mayur Khandeparkar, for X, said the plaintiffs must initiate contempt proceedings against the defendants instead of waging a proxy battle with an intermediary.Justice Godse said it is undisputed that the objectionable content is still available with X. Tengra uploaded the fresh video not only in blatant defiance of HC’s injunction order “but he also states that he will not comply with the directions of the court and that he would not stop calling plaintiff no. 2 (Poonawalla) ‘a mass murderer’.”The judge noted there were no directions to X to remove the objectionable content and, thus, it cannot be held liable for the objectionable content not removed by the five defendants or for the new content uploaded by Tengra. Citing a Supreme Court judgment, she said even if an intermediary is exempt from liability for third-party information, necessary directions can be issued to remove the unlawful or prohibited content.Considering the “subsequent circumstance” of Tengra uploading the fresh video, Justice Godse said sufficient grounds are made out to direct X to “remove, delete or disable access” to the fresh video uploaded by Tengra.
Article Summary: Bombay high court has directed x corp to remove a video against serum institute of india pvt ltd and its ceo adar poonawalla. The video was uploaded by social media influencer yohan tengra immediately after its june 5, 2023 order. Justice gauri godse of hc on tuesday passed the order on an interim application in the pending defamation suit.

Article Title: India's factory growth hits 7 month high in September, thanks to demand and hiring boost
Article Text:
Factory growth hits 7-month high, PMI rises to 55.1

India’s manufacturing activity scaled up sharply in September, as stronger demand pushed up sales and production, while companies stepped up hiring and stock-building.The seasonally adjusted HSBC India Manufacturing Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) rose to 55.1 in September, from 52.8 in August, marking the strongest improvement in the sector’s health in seven months. A PMI reading above 50 indicates expansion, while a reading below 50 signals contraction.The recovery in factory activity was supported by both domestic and overseas demand. Stronger new orders helped drive production higher, with demand across electronics, food, pharma and textiles taking total sales growth to its highest level since February.Export orders also gained momentum during the month, with manufacturers reporting increased business from clients in Brazil, Europe, the UAE and the US."India's factory sector ended the quarter on a firmer footing. The PMI rose to 55.1 in September, up from 52.8, as stronger domestic and overseas demand lifted sales and production. Hiring resumed at its fastest pace since May, and manufacturers became more optimistic about the months ahead," Pranjul Bhandari, chief India economist at HSBC, told PTI.The improvement in demand was accompanied by a renewed increase in factory employment.After a blip in August, job growth resumed in September, with the pace of employment expansion described by panellists as solid and the strongest since May.Manufacturers also became more confident about the months ahead. Output forecasts were upgraded during September, taking overall positive sentiment to a four-month high. The outlook was supported by a healthy pipeline of new enquiries and expectations that strong demand would continue.The expectation of higher future sales also prompted companies to increase their purchases of materials and build inventories. Overall buying activity expanded at a faster pace than in August."Companies bought more materials and built up stocks to prepare for anticipated sales. Finished goods inventories recorded their second-largest increase in nearly 12 years, signalling a clear shift from leaner stock levels," Bhandari said.Finished goods inventories rose for the third consecutive month. The increase was the second-fastest in 11-and-a-half years, behind July, as manufacturers actively accumulated stocks in anticipation of stronger demand.At the same time, companies faced quicker increases in input costs and selling prices. Despite the acceleration, the rates of inflation remained mild by historical standards.The September reading came as manufacturing activity regained momentum after the slower expansion recorded in August, with the PMI rising by more than two points during the month."Holdings of finished products increased for the third month in a row and at the second-fastest pace in 11-and-a-half years (behind July)," the report said.The HSBC India Manufacturing PMI is compiled by S&P Global based on responses from purchasing managers at around 400 manufacturers.
Article Summary: Factory growth hits 7-month high, pmi rises to 55.1. Stronger demand pushed up sales and production, while companies stepped up hiring and stock-building. Hiring resumed at its fastest pace since may, and manufacturers became more optimistic about the months ahead.

Article Title: Anthropic targets $2 trillion valuation despite huge spending and billions in losses
Article Text:
Anthropic targets $2 trillion valuation despite huge spending and billions in losses

Revenue growth draws investor attention

Huge infrastructure spending

Losses add to valuation questions

Customer concentration remains a risk

Anthropic has put a massive price tag on the AI boom, backing it with an equally heavy spending plan.The AI giant is heading towards a potential valuation of more than $2 trillion even as it plans $518 billion in cloud computing and infrastructure obligations in the coming years.The company’s IPO prospectus, seen by Reuters, also shows just how quickly its business has grown. Anthropic’s revenue reportedly rose 12-fold in 2025, giving investors a strong growth story to weigh against its continuing losses and huge infrastructure commitments.The scale of its plans has also spilled into markets, with European technology shares rising 2.4% and the US chip index gaining 1.5%.For investors, Anthropic’s rapid expansion is a key part of the valuation story.Michael Field, chief equity strategist at Morningstar, Amsterdam, said the speed of the company’s growth stood out in the prospectus."If anything, the acceleration of the business is the biggest part of this release. Growing a big business can be difficult, but the prospectus stating that revenue grew by 12 fold in 2025 is truly remarkable."Field said the proposed valuation should be considered alongside the company’s sales."Obviously a $2 trillion valuation sounds outlandish, but when you break it down to a multiple of sales, likely to be around 18-20x, it sounds much more reasonable than the recent SpaceX IPO."Anthropic’s plans also show that the AI investment cycle is continuing to require substantial spending on infrastructure.Kathleen Brooks, research director at XTB Platform, London, said the planned spending was positive for companies involved in semiconductors and AI infrastructure."This is positive for the AI trade, since it is fuelled by continued elevated levels of capex spend. The fact that Anthropic is planning on spending big on capex means that the capex cycle is not over yet. This is good news for semiconductor and AI infrastructure companies. I believe that if Anthropic had signalled a lower level of spending, this could have caused a wobble in the AI trade, since it would lead to fears about the sustainability of the AI trade as we move into Q4. "The prospectus puts rapid revenue growth alongside the large infrastructure commitments needed to support it.Susannah Streeter, chief investment strategist at Wealth Club, London, said Anthropic’s expectations for AI’s economic impact appeared to have supported demand for European technology stocks."It's the vision and the projections to the extent to which Anthropic believes AI will be a game changer for economies around the world that seem to have lifted demand for European tech stocks."She also raised concerns over the company’s spending while it remains loss-making."There still will be niggles of concern among some about the huge sums that are projected to be spent even though it is making a loss. But that hasn't caused a flutter of general fear because, overall, there still seems to be a pretty hefty appetite for AI focused investments."Anthropic’s losses remain another factor in the debate around its proposed valuation.Field said the losses were a concern when considered against the company’s current revenue, growth rate and size. However, he said investors had already absorbed much of the spending story."The losses certainly are a concern. Particularly given the growth rate and the size relative to current revenues. It's unlikely to deter investors, however, with the spend story having been digested for some time now."He said the scale of planned investment also reflected management’s confidence in future demand."The key takeaway for investors is the confidence in the business and the AI strategy. Yes spend is high and growing, but management obviously feel the growth rate inherent in demand is sufficiently attractive to keep spending, hence why they are coming to market and demanding a top-dollar valuation."Anthropic’s revenue growth is another area attracting attention, particularly because a significant share reportedly comes from a small number of customers.Dan Coatsworth, head of markets at AJ Bell, London, said the company’s revenue growth had become the main focus despite its spending plans. "Massive spending would normally have investors running for the hills, but what's capturing the market's attention is Anthropic's stellar revenue growth, up 12-fold in 2025. Admittedly, AI is moving at such a rapid pace that last year’s sales achievements relate to technology that is already outdated. "Anthropic’s IPO plans therefore bring together rapid revenue growth, continuing losses and a huge infrastructure commitment. The company is seeking a valuation of more than $2 trillion while planning $518 billion in cloud computing and infrastructure obligations.
Article Summary: Anthropic targets $2 trillion valuation despite huge spending and billions in losses. Revenues reportedly rose 12-fold in 2025, giving investors a strong growth story to weigh against its continuing losses and huge infrastructure commitments. European technology shares rose 2.4% and the us chip index gained 1.5%.

Article Title: Google data center head says that there are 'hundreds of thousands' of skilled trade jobs across the US as the company launches commitment to help 25,000 ...
Article Text:
A personal story behind the push

What the commitment includes

Why the need is so urgent

Part of a broader pattern of investment

Google has announced a major initiative to help 25,000 US veterans and military families transition into skilled trade careers, as demand for electricians, pipefitters, and project managers surges amid the AI-driven data center boom. Tim Chadwick, Google’s Data Center Operations Area Lead, says there are “hundreds of thousands” of skilled trade jobs open across the country right now. Data centers have become central to the AI economy, requiring massive investment and labor. Google estimates that hundreds of thousands of skilled trade roles are currently unfilled across the U.S., ranging from master electricians to project managers. These jobs offer long-term stability and high wages, but employers face challenges in recruiting due to decades of emphasis on four-year degrees over vocational training.The announcement was written by Tim Chadwick, Google's Data Center Operations Area lead for Ohio and Indiana, who shared his own path from military service into the tech industry. Chadwick spent seven years as a nuclear-trained operator in the US Navy and another 13 years as a submarine officer before transitioning to civilian life — a shift he described as genuinely difficult, one he credits his professional network with helping him navigate.A former shipmate ultimately helped him land an interview for a role managing data center engineering operations.Chadwick noted that many of the skills built while running a nuclear submarine — planning and leading a mission, working closely with technicians, and exercising sound judgment under pressure — translate directly into overseeing data center operations, a connection that shaped his interest in helping other veterans find similar paths.Google.org's funding and support will flow to three organizations with deep experience serving the veteran community: Hiring Our Heroes, Student Veterans of America (SVA), and the Home Builders Institute (HBI). Together, these organizations will offer hands-on pre-apprenticeships, career coaching, and direct job placement support aimed at helping veterans and military family members move into skilled trade careers.Chadwick pointed to the sheer scale of unmet demand driving the initiative, noting that hundreds of thousands of skilled trade roles are currently open across the US, spanning positions like master electrician, lead pipefitter, and project manager. He described these as high-growth careers offering long-term financial stability — and argued that veterans and military families are especially well-suited for them, given how closely the roles align with skills many already carry from military service, including problem-solving under pressure, teamwork, and a strong drive to get a job done right.This isn't Google's first move in this space. Earlier this year, the company joined BlackRock, Ford, and Carhartt to launch the Alliance for America's Skilled Trades, aimed at building stronger pipelines into vocational careers nationally. Google.org has also previously funded the Electrical Training Alliance (etA) to bring AI-powered learning tools directly onto the trade floor, and provided a $4 million grant to Student Veterans of America to expand access to Google Career Certificates and AI training for veterans nationwide.Today's announcement is also part of Google.org's broader AI Opportunity Fund for the United States, an initiative aimed at ensuring Americans across different career paths can benefit from advances in AI technology, rather than being left behind by them.
Article Summary: Google has announced a major initiative to help 25,000 us veterans and military families transition into skilled trade careers. The move comes as demand for electricians, pipefitters, and project managers surges amid the ai-driven data center boom. Google estimates that hundreds of thousands of skilled trade roles are currently unfilled across the u.s.

Article Title: Apple Pay launches in India; here's how to set it up and where you can use it
Article Text:
Apple Pay launched in India: How it works, and who can use it

How to set up and use Apple Pay

Where you can use it

Apple has officially launched Apple Pay in India. With this launch the company brings its secure and seamless payment system to iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch users, with Mac support coming soon. Apple Pay roll out in the country will enable users to pay in stores, apps, and on the web without typing PINs and OTPs marking a significant milestone in India’s fast-growing digital payments ecosystem. At launch, Apple Pay supports Axis Bank-issued Visa and Mastercard credit cards, enabling payments at thousands of merchants across India and anywhere NFC transactions are accepted globally.Apple also emphasised that privacy remains central to how Apple Pay functions. When a card is added, the actual card number is never stored on the device or Apple's servers, nor shared with merchants during a transaction. Instead, the system assigns a unique Device Account Number, which is encrypted and stored securely within the device's Secure Element — a certified, industry-standard chip built specifically to protect payment information.Presently, Apple Pay is exclusively available to customers holding Axis Bank-issued Visa and Mastercard credit cards, letting them add those cards to Apple Pay and use them at thousands of in-store and online merchants across India, as well as anywhere that accepts NFC transactions.Jennifer Bailey, Apple's vice president of Apple Pay and Apple Wallet, framed the launch as a natural fit for India's fast-growing digital economy, pointing to the country's dynamic, digitally savvy population that's increasingly embracing cashless payments while expecting strong security and privacy standards. She described Apple Pay's core value proposition as making everyday card payments easy, secure, and private — from a simple tap in stores without needing a separate app, PIN, or OTP, to checking out online without repeatedly re-entering payment details.Apple Pay is easy to set up. Customers can add a card directly to Apple Wallet via the latest version of the Axis Bank app. Alternatively, simply open the Wallet app on iPhone, tap the plus sign, and follow the steps to add an eligible card. Once a user adds a card to their Apple device, they can start using Apple Pay right away.Using Apple Pay in stores is seamless and easy. Simply double-click the side button or Home button; authenticate using Face ID, Touch ID, or a device passcode if prompted; and hold the top of the iPhone or display of the Apple Watch near the contactless reader to pay. When using Apple Pay, users will continue to earn the rewards and benefits offered by their cards.At launch, Apple Pay will be accepted at millions of merchants across India, including Apple Store locations, Blinkit, Chaayos, Comet, Croma, Interflora, Ixigo, Le15 Patisserie, Reliance brands, Tata 1mg, and Zomato, among others. Apple has also partnered with several payment service providers, including Cashfree, JusPay, Mswipe, Paytm, PayU, Pine Labs, Razorpay, and Worldline, to extend Apple Pay's reach across their respective merchant networks, with more merchants and apps expected to be added over time.Globally, Apple Pay is now available in more than 90 countries and regions, working with over 11,000 bank and network partners worldwide — making India one of the more prominent recent additions to that global rollout.
Article Summary: Apple has officially launched apple pay in india. With this launch the company brings its secure and seamless payment system to iphone, ipad and apple watch users, with mac support coming soon. Apple pay roll out in the country will enable users to pay in stores, apps, and on the web without typing pins and otps.

Article Title: Anthropic warns AI may pose ‘existential risks to humanity’ in IPO filing
Article Text:
Anthropic

Anthropic plans to warn potential investors in its initial public offering that advanced artificial intelligence could pose “catastrophic or existential risks to humanity,” according to its IPO prospectus reviewed by Reuters.The filing says its AI models could exhibit “self-preserving behaviours,” including attempts to “resist shutdown,” “conceal or manipulate information” and behaviour “resembling blackmail”. “Our development of highly advanced models, platforms, and applications and expansion of use cases could further increase the risk that our models cause harm,” Anthropic said.The company, which positions itself as a safety-first AI lab, devoted 80 pages of prospectus’s 261-page main body to risks, nearly twice the 48 pages describing its business. SpaceX, which owns xAI, devoted about 38 of 277 pages to risks.Anthropic said models could develop unexpected capabilities during training that might be discovered only after deployment and had resulted in significant safety incidents. It also warned that models might recognise evaluations and modify their behaviour, limiting safety assessments. Researchers have similarly warned that increasingly capable models can recognise when they are being watched and adjust their behaviour, complicating monitoring.Anthropic and other developers, including OpenAI, have faced scrutiny after experimental systems defied constraints, including a reported breach of Australia’s health-system database by an OpenAI model. Anthropic safety researcher Evan Hubinger estimated a greater than 10% probability that AI could kill humans within the next decade, echoing former colleague Jacob Coxon.Despite emphasising safety, Anthropic said returns on such investment were unclear and did not disclose its spending. Earlier this month, it said safety work used about 6% of its AI research computing power during a sample week in July. It called safety efforts “resource-intensive” and said limited funds must be divided among computing power, costly AI talent and safety.The Claude developer said customer usage and revenue depended on new models and that a “continuous and overlapping cadence” of releases was “inherent to remaining at the frontier of AI development.” Last week, it released a new Opus model, 10 days after CEO Dario Amodei published a nearly 4,000-word essay urging the frontier to be paced.Anthropic has pledged to publish more data on its use of AI models to build future generations as experts warn about recursive self-improvement, when models develop without human help. Anthropic declined to comment. Analysts said slowing down could hand rivals an advantage. Anthropic declined to comment in response to a request for comment.
Article Summary: Anthropic plans to warn potential investors in its initial public offering that advanced artificial intelligence could pose “catastrophic or existential risks to humanity” the company, which positions itself as a safety-first ai lab, devoted 80 pages of prospectus’s 261-page main body to risks.

Article Title: AT&T CEO John Stankey 'agrees' with T-Mobile CEO Peter Osvaldik that Elon Musk's plans to shake up mobile industry with Starlink should be laughed out of the room
Article Text:
What T-Mobile CEO Peter Osvaldik said first

AT&T CEO John Stankey's rebuttal: Fiber beats satellite, full stop

Why the rivalry is heating up

The scale of Starlink's ambitions

Why Stankey says the math doesn't work

AT&T CEO John Stankey has sided with T-Mobile’s chief executive Peter Osvaldik in rejecting Elon Musk ’s plan to disrupt the mobile industry with Starlink. Speaking to Axios, Stankey said SpaceX ’s proposal to turn its satellite business into a global competitor to traditional telecom networks is “not a viable strategy.” He argued that fiber infrastructure remains superior, noting AT&T’s $3 billion deal with Corning to expand its fiber footprint. Earlier this month, T-Mobile CEO Peter Osvaldik dismissed Musk’s Starlink ambitions outright, and said that the strategy should be “laughed out of the room. ” Osvaldik said Starlink’s approach lacked the scale and economics to compete with established carriers, reinforcing skepticism across the telecom industry.T-Mobile CFO Peter Osvaldik was blunt in his own assessment of Starlink's mobile ambitions, saying that "everybody in the know" is laughing at parts of the plan, and describing SpaceX's proposal as something that isn't fathomable from a technical standpoint. He argued Starlink doesn't represent a real competitive threat from a wireless perspective, pointing to basic physics as the core obstacle: satellite signals, he said, can't penetrate buildings, walls, or even something as simple as a car windshield, making Starlink's direct-to-cell ambitions far less practical in dense urban environments than in the remote areas where satellite coverage genuinely shines.Speaking to Axios, Stankey made a similarly confident case for why AT&T isn't worried, backing it with a major infrastructure move. AT&T announced a $3 billion deal with Corning this week to expand its fiber infrastructure, arguing that fiber delivers speeds three times faster than satellite technology. Stankey didn't mince words about the comparison, saying nothing beats fiber, and that even if satellite technology performs at its absolute best over the next decade, it still won't be able to match what fiber delivers.The pushback from both carriers comes as Musk and SpaceX President Gwynne Shotwell have been increasingly vocal about turning Starlink into a genuine competitor to traditional phone and internet providers. Starlink already competes with legacy telecom companies for home and business internet customers, and the company has now started talking openly about a mobile business that would put it in direct competition with wireless carriers.Shotwell added fuel to that narrative in August, during SpaceX's first earnings call as a public company, predicting that SpaceX would be able to win over a meaningful number of customers from existing carriers because its service would simply be better. That comment rattled markets, sending shares of AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile lower the following day.As of June 30, Starlink had 12 million subscribers and more than 10,200 satellites providing coverage across 167 countries, according to SpaceX's first earnings report as a public company. While SpaceX's rockets and AI work tend to dominate headlines, its connectivity business is actually the company's largest revenue driver, accounting for 55% of total sales.Becoming a genuine fourth major US mobile carrier, however, would require significantly more terrestrial infrastructure to match the capacity of a traditional cellular network — a build-out one analyst estimated could cost SpaceX more than $100 billion. SpaceX believes it has found a cheaper alternative: installing small cellular base stations alongside Starlink dishes at homes and businesses, adding capacity where satellite coverage alone falls short, without needing to build the kind of sprawling cell tower network traditional carriers rely on. Musk has claimed these small stations could eventually deliver connectivity to phones with better and higher bandwidth than what's currently available from existing cellular providers.Stankey pushed back hard on that plan's feasibility, arguing that installing enough small stations to match a traditional network's capacity would cost roughly the same as simply building a full macro cellular network. He also pointed to a significant regulatory hurdle: current law doesn't allow companies to radiate cellular signals from someone's home without their permission, unless that law changes. He suggested that if the approach were genuinely viable and cost-effective, AT&T would already be installing similar antennas across its own massive existing fiber network.
Article Summary: At&t ceo john stankey says spacex's starlink plan is "not a viable strategy" he argued that fiber infrastructure remains superior, noting at&t’s $3 billion deal with corning to expand its fiber footprint. Earlier this month, t-mobile ceo peter osvaldik said starlink's approach lacked the scale and economics to compete with established carriers.

Pebble Qore Ultra features

Pebble Qore Ultra price and availability

Article Title: A New Jersey woman paid $25 for a mouldy table at a garage sale; 30 years later, it was identified as a rare 18th-century card table made by John Seymour & Son and sold for $541,500
Article Text:
From a $25 garage-sale table to a rare 18th-century discovery

Experts identify a rare Federal-period table

The $25 table was appraised at up to $300,000

The table heads to Sotheby's

From a garage sale to a $541,500 auction

Why the original condition mattered

A $25 purchase becomes an American furniture landmark

A New Jersey schoolteacher who bought a mouldy, pitch-black table at a garage sale for just $25 ended up owning a rare piece of American furniture worth more than half a million dollars. Claire Wiegand-Beckmann purchased the table roughly three decades before it appeared on Antiques Roadshow, when she was moving into a new home and wanted a small table. She initially saw little reason to believe it was valuable. But when furniture expert Leigh Keno examined it in Secaucus, New Jersey, in 1997, he discovered an original maker's label identifying it as the work of Boston cabinetmakers John and Thomas Seymour. The table was later sold at Sotheby's for $490,000, with the buyer's premium bringing the total to $541,500.Wiegand-Beckmann came across the table at a garage sale in New Jersey while she was moving into a new house. She told Antiques Roadshow that she needed a small table and thought the piece might work for the space.It was hardly an obvious treasure. She recalled that it was “pitch black” and “a moldy mess” when she saw it outside at the sale.The seller had priced it at $30, but Wiegand-Beckmann said she had only $25 with her. The seller agreed to accept the lower amount, allowing her to take the table home.The purchase was made roughly 30 years before her appearance on Antiques Roadshow. For years, the table was simply a piece of furniture in her Bergen County home. At the time she bought it, there was no indication that the seemingly battered table was a significant example of early American furniture.The turning point came in 1997, when Antiques Roadshow held an event in Secaucus, New Jersey. Wiegand-Beckmann decided to bring the table along to see whether experts could tell her more about it.The table reportedly arrived in an unusual fashion. Because it was awkward and wobbly, Wiegand-Beckmann brought it into the event upside down on a cart. That made the object look even less like an important piece of antique furniture.It was examined by furniture specialist Leigh Keno, who immediately began looking at its construction, decorative inlay and other characteristics. But one detail proved especially important: the table still had its original maker's label.The label read John Seymour and Son, Creek Square, Boston. Keno explained that surviving furniture with an original label from the makers was exceptionally rare.Keno identified the piece as a Federal inlaid mahogany demi-lune card table made by John and Thomas Seymour, Boston cabinetmakers working in the late 18th and early 19th centuries.The table is dated to about 1794. PBS classifies it as an 18th-century piece and identifies its material as mahogany. Keno highlighted its figured mahogany, satinwood inlay and distinctive decorative details as evidence of its quality.The Seymour name was particularly significant. John and Thomas Seymour were prominent Boston furniture makers whose work was produced for wealthy families of the period. The surviving label gave specialists an unusually direct connection between the table and its makers.Keno told Wiegand-Beckmann that the table was an exceptional example of Federal furniture. Its craftsmanship, original features and maker's label all contributed to its importance.The discovery transformed Wiegand-Beckmann's expectations. When Keno examined the table in 1997, the initial auction estimate was $200,000 to $300,000. The appraiser suggested that on a particularly good day it could potentially bring $300,000.That was already an extraordinary increase from the $25 garage-sale price.PBS later updated the auction valuation for the piece to 400,000-600,000 in its records. The broadcaster also notes that valuations can change over time depending on market conditions and the circumstances of a sale.The original $25 purchase price therefore represented only a tiny fraction of what specialists believed the table could command at auction.After the Antiques Roadshow appraisal, Wiegand-Beckmann contacted Keno about selling the table. The process eventually took it to Sotheby's in New York, where it was offered as part of the auction house's Important Americana furniture and folk art sale in January 1998.The auction attracted collectors interested in American furniture. Bidding quickly moved far beyond the original estimate.According to PBS's later account of the auction, bidding reached $490,000, at which point the table was sold. The $490,000 figure was the hammer price. Once Sotheby's buyer's premium was added, the total selling price reached $541,500.The auction result was described by PBS as a world record for Federal furniture at the time.The transformation was extraordinary. Wiegand-Beckmann had paid $25 for a table that looked dirty, damaged and unremarkable. Around three decades later, that same piece became a highly sought-after example of Federal-period American furniture.The difference between the purchase price and auction result was enormous. The $541,500 final price, including the buyer's premium, was 21,660 times the $25 that Wiegand-Beckmann had originally paid.The table's value was not simply a consequence of its age. Its rarity, original label, original finish, craftsmanship and association with John and Thomas Seymour all played important roles. Keno specifically noted that the label was unusually valuable evidence because labelled examples of the makers' work were rare.One of the unusual aspects of the story is that the table's battered appearance could easily have encouraged its owner to clean or refinish it extensively.Wiegand-Beckmann told the Antiques Roadshow team that she had used linseed oil and turpentine on the table but did not refinish it. That proved significant because retaining its original finish helped preserve the characteristics that specialists valued.Keno later explained that the table's rarity, original label and original finish were among the factors that made it such an important piece.The story has remained one of Antiques Roadshow's most memorable discoveries because the table looked so ordinary when Wiegand-Beckmann bought it. She had gone to a garage sale looking for a small piece of furniture, negotiated the price down to what she could afford and took home what appeared to be a battered old table.Instead, she had acquired a rare example of Federal-period craftsmanship by two important Boston cabinetmakers.
Article Summary: Claire wiegand-beckmann came across the table at a garage sale in new jersey while she was moving into a new house. She initially saw little reason to believe it was valuable. But when furniture expert leigh keno examined it in 1997, he discovered an original maker's label identifying it as the work of boston cabinetmakers john and thomas seymour.

Article Title: Kentucky woman started a $300 eBay side hustle in 2011, left her $35,000 insurance job in 2014; 10 years later, Pink Lily reached $141 million
Article Text:
PC: CNBC

How a $300 eBay clothing side hustle became Pink Lily

How Tori Gerbig took Pink Lily from eBay to its own website

Tori and Chris Gerbig take Pink Lily full-time as sales surge

PC: CNBC

From an eBay shop to a larger retail operation

Social media became part of the retail model

Customers were also used as brand ambassadors

Pink Lily bought entire inventories to offer exclusive clothing

What started in a living room had become a $141 million business

In 2011, Tori and Chris Gerbig were not setting out to build a large fashion retailer. They were a young Kentucky couple with an interest in affordable women’s clothing and about $300 to put into a small online venture. Writing for CNBC in 2022, Tori revealed that she was still working in insurance, at that time while the clothing business ran alongside their jobs and family life. What began with listings on eBay gradually developed into Pink Lily, an online fashion company based in Bowling Green, Kentucky. Ten years after that first investment, the business reported $141 million in gross sales for the year, illustrating how a modest online shop had grown into a sizeable retail operation.The Gerbigs launched their eBay shop in 2011 after noticing that finding fashionable women's clothes at relatively low prices was not always straightforward. They put roughly $300 into their first batch of clothing and accessories, buying stock through a wholesale website.At that stage, the operation was deliberately small. Tori continued working her insurance job while she and Chris handled orders from their living room.There was little in the way of fixed business overhead, although shipping costs had to be covered.Their approach to pricing was fairly simple at first. Tori had no previous experience in retail pricing, so she based prices on what she would have been willing to pay as a customer. The business was not producing anything close to the figures it would later report, but it was generating enough to keep the experiment going.During the first few years, monthly profits generally ranged between $300 and $1,000. Rather than treating that money as household income, the couple used it to pay down student loans and buy more stock.The business began to take on a different shape as Tori spent more time building relationships with suppliers. She travelled to Los Angeles to meet vendors and began attending trade shows, giving the couple access to a wider selection of products.In 2013, Tori also created a Facebook group to promote the clothing to potential customers. The group helped create a direct line between the business and shoppers, particularly around Bowling Green, Kentucky.That year proved important for the company. The Gerbigs had accumulated about $20,000 from the business, which they used to build an official website for Pink Lily. The move took the operation beyond its original eBay model and gave the couple a dedicated place to sell their growing range. The change was followed by a sharp increase in revenue.By May 2014, Pink Lily was generating more than $100,000 in monthly revenue. After three years of running the business alongside her employment, Tori left her insurance sales job of earning $35,000 per year and began working on Pink Lily full-time.Chris followed several months later. His role centred on the company's finances and operations, while the business continued expanding its product range and customer base. Pink Lily finished 2014 with more than $4 million in revenue. The figures were a long way from the $300 monthly investment that had started the venture just a few years earlier.The company continued to grow over the following years. By 2019, Pink Lily had recorded $70 million in total sales and brought in a minority investment to help support its expansion.By the time Gerbig described the company's progress in 2022, Pink Lily was selling more than 11,000 products on its website and had also opened a physical shop. The business employed about 250 full-time workers in Bowling Green, where it had become one of the larger employers in the area.The Gerbigs still attended trade shows, but Pink Lily had developed a core group of vendor relationships and was working with partners on custom designs. That represented a considerable shift from the couple's original model of buying clothing wholesale and listing individual items on eBay. The company had developed its own retail identity and a much larger supply operation.Then came the sales figure that put the scale of that expansion into perspective. In 2021, Pink Lily generated $141 million in gross sales, according to Gerbig's account published by CNBC in February 2022.Pink Lily's growth was also tied to how the company used social media. Rather than treating platforms such as Instagram simply as advertising channels, the business used its audience to gather feedback about products and potential brands. Customers were asked what they wanted to see on the website and in the shop. The company could then use those responses when deciding which products to stock.The strategy extended to customers sharing photographs of their purchases. Pink Lily sent orders in branded bags and encouraged shoppers to post their outfits using the company's hashtag. Some of that customer content was then featured on the Pink Lily website.Tori Gerbig said, “At first, it was just a fun hobby. Little did I know, 10 years later, my husband Chris and I would be running Pink Lily full-time. Last year, our online clothing business generated $141 million in gross sales. And today, our social media audience has grown to 3.6 million followers.”Pink Lily developed a paid ambassador programme around some of its longstanding customers. Participants received a 10% commission on sales generated through their promotion of the brand. It was not a small part of the company's marketing activity. Gerbig said the ambassador programme generated about $7.5 million in sales in 2021.The model gave Pink Lily another way of reaching shoppers through people who already bought its products. Instead of relying entirely on conventional advertising, the company incorporated existing customers into its sales and promotional system.As Pink Lily became larger, the Gerbigs also looked for ways to make some of its merchandise less interchangeable with products available from other retailers. In certain cases, the company would purchase a vendor's entire inventory of a particular item. That meant the same product could not simply appear elsewhere through another retailer using the same supplier. This approach helped Pink Lily assemble collections that were specific to its own store rather than relying exclusively on products that shoppers could find across multiple online retailers.The distance between Pink Lily's first year and its reported 2021 sales is substantial. The company began with about $300 worth of inventory, a living-room workspace and two people managing the operation around existing commitments. Three years later, Tori had left her insurance career after the side business began generating six-figure monthly revenue. Chris then joined her full-time, and the company moved from a small eBay seller into its own online retail operation.By 2021, Pink Lily had reached $141 million in gross sales, employed around 250 people and sold thousands of products through its website and physical shop. The business had also taken outside minority investment and developed a network of suppliers and customer ambassadors.
Article Summary: Tori and chris gerbig started pink lily as a small ebay business in 2011. The kentucky couple invested $300 and ran the business from their living room. The business grew from a modest online shop to a larger retail operation. By 2022, pink lily was selling more than 11,000 products on its website and had also opened a physical shop.

Article Title: Pakistan goes bananas over giant gorillas dancing to Bollywood songs
Article Text:
Clips of these larger-than-life performers have been spreading rapidly online (Photo: AFP)

Pakistanis are going bananas over a trend that has crossed the Indian border: Giant gorillas, dancing to Bollywood music.Clips of these larger-than-life performers have been spreading rapidly online, turning them into the surprise stars of weddings, birthdays and other festivities.In the videos, guests can be seen joining in alongside the costumed entertainers, many of them visibly delighted by the unusual addition to their celebrations. The performers swing their oversized arms to pounding DJ tracks while partygoers gather round and dance, creating a lively, comic spectacle that has quickly drawn attention across social media.Behind the trend in Lahore is Shayen Zahoor, who runs Gorilla.co.pk, a business offering giant dancing gorilla acts for events across the city.Speaking to AFP, Zahoor explained how quickly the idea took off. He said the costume was ordered in early April and arrived by the end of the same month, after which the team wasted no time putting it to use.Once the suit arrived, he and his team lost no time getting started."We uploaded a reel on Instagram, and within just two days it reached a million views," Zahoor recalled.The overwhelming response convinced them to treat the venture as a serious business, and bookings soon began pouring in, with the public reaction proving remarkably enthusiastic."On the very first day, we received approximately 1,200 to 1,300 messages," he said, describing how curious would-be customers flooded his inbox.Many wanted to know whether the costume had genuinely arrived, what it would cost to book, and other practical details before making up their minds.What began as a single Instagram reel has since snowballed into a full-fledged entertainment phenomenon, with giant gorillas now a familiar, if unlikely, fixture at Pakistani celebrations.
